biography.plain_text: Fernando Espinosa Abdalá is a Mexican pharmaceutical billionaire and former operational president of Rimsa. His father founded the business as a distributor before it expanded into manufacturing. Fernando and his brother Leopoldo later owned and ran the company, selling it to Teva Pharmaceuticals and converting the family enterprise into the foundation of their investment wealth.

long_biography.plain_text:
Rimsa grew from pharmaceutical distribution into manufacturing during Fernando Espinosa Abdalá's operating tenure. The Mexican company developed a portfolio of prescription products and became a significant supplier to the national health sector. Sustained growth gave the privately held manufacturer the scale to attract an international buyer.

Teva completed the acquisition in 2016, purchasing Rimsa's operating companies, intellectual property, assets and pharmaceutical patents across Latin America and Europe. The transaction transferred a broad manufacturing and distribution platform, not merely a company name. It also marked the end of Fernando's executive responsibility for the pharmaceutical business.
